reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question by proposing a specific, testable mechanism (interface-mediated dislocation source activation) with a clear intervention (varying interfacial coherency), measurable outcomes, and a well-defined falsification experiment, all grounded in established deformation physics without overreliance on cited evidence.
